paper_title: Machine learning center-specific models show improved IVF live birth predictions over US national registry-based model
prediction_task: Binary prediction of IVF live birth per first cycle using center-specific GBM vs SART national registry model

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Missing calibration plots, Brier scores, and 95% CIs with paired DeLong AUC tests; TRIPOD-AI compliance requires full metric panel including calibration curves.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added calibration plots (Figure 1A; Supplemental Figure 2 per-clinic), Brier scores (Table 4), and paired DeLong test results at clinic level (Supplementary Tables 1-2).

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Results are aggregated across 6 clinics without per-clinic descriptive statistics (AMH, age) or per-clinic reclassification tables, limiting interpretability of center-specific claims.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added per-clinic summary table (Table 3), per-clinic reclassification tables (Supplementary Tables 5A-F), and per-clinic calibration plots.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Sole use of GBM without comparisons to Random Forest, CatBoost, or LightGBM leaves unclear whether gains come from MLCS framework, algorithm choice, or additional predictors.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Clarified that comparing ML algorithms was not the main goal; emphasized center-specificity/ML combination as a framework, declined additional algorithm sweep.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Code not available for review; preprocessing pipelines of proprietary MLCS framework not disclosed; conflict of interest from Univfy raises reproducibility concerns.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Uploaded code plus dummy dataset to Code Ocean; explicitly disclosed COI; explained clinical data sharing is not standard in IVF field.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: PGT-A usage not excluded/adjusted despite likely large impact on SART model performance; confounders across centers uncontrolled.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added discussion that neither MLCS nor SART address PGT-A/ICSI add-ons; noted as area for future work.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Commercial-toned discussion overclaims value-based IVF pricing without supporting financial data; reviewer requested toning down of promotional language and adding limitations section.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Removed commercial paragraph; added full limitations section covering key limitations of per-center design and generalizability.
